findings.rationale: Correct: an mtime age filter on lane totals lets aged dispatches and turns drop out. Folded: §2.5 now states lane totals use every transcript of the session whatever its age, only the root-hour total filters (by turn ts, optionally skipping files older than 60 min by mtime); §6 latency relies on the (path,size,mtimeMs) parse cache instead; §5 control 7 plants four old dispatches and 300 old turns.

Correct: the window lacked a clock and boundary. Folded: §2.5 Clock line — one now sampled at hook entry, injectable via AUTOPILOT_SUBAGENT_BUDGET_NOW_MS; interval now-3600000 < ts <= now; future ts counts; missing/unparseable ts counts for lane totals only. §5 control 9 tests the 60-minute boundary.

Correct: six controls left checks uncovered. Folded: §5 controls 7-13 cover age filtering, each turn ceiling separately, the hour boundary, a 7-character reason, the dropped context line, fail-open on a corrupt transcript, and an injected latency over the bound.

Folded now rather than later: §2.5 binds the slug to ^Lane:[ \t]*([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63})[ \t]*$ applied identically to briefs and subagent transcripts, and names the fallbacks: malformed or empty Lane line -> description first line; empty description -> no lane (root total only); only the first 5 lines are read, so a quoted Lane: later in a brief never matches.
